recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-14469 unless PA later changes Appointment.reason semantics independently of the basedOn request relationship.
issue_request: FHIR-14469 was a Published PA change request for STU3, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked to update Appointment indication so a procedure-to-be-performed could be represented by ProcedureRequest, and also noted the typo "Reason the appointment is to takes place".
initial_application: No direct git commit mentioning FHIR-14469 was found. The relevant application occurred through the Appointment request-reference history: FHIR-13195 renamed Appointment.incomingReferral to Appointment.basedOn, while historical commits merged ReferralRequest with ProcedureRequest and then renamed ProcedureRequest to ServiceRequest.
additional_context: Appointment is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Appointment.basedOn explicitly describes an incoming referral or procedure request, aliases incomingReferral, and targets ServiceRequest, which is the current successor for the old ProcedureRequest/ReferralRequest request scope. Current Appointment.reason has clean wording and no remaining "to takes place" typo. FHIR-25278 later expanded basedOn targets and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Adding a legacy ProcedureRequest target or moving the request relationship back into Appointment.reason/indication would be stale for current FHIR source.

related_jiras.note: Established Appointment.basedOn as the generalized prior-order/procedure-request relationship that satisfied FHIR-14469.
Later expanded Appointment.basedOn request targets while preserving ServiceRequest and the reason-vs-basedOn separation; already represented on the combined branch.
